Here’s a quick recap of the story so far:
Playtime Co. is a company created by Elliot Ludwig. This company was known for taking in orphans and giving them a home where they had access to all things necessary for their development. The public didn’t know that in actuality Elliot and Playtime Co. were experimenting on the orphans and turning them into toys (that’s why there are no bodies, but a lot of bloody toy parts all across Playtime Co.). The point of this was for whoever is The Prototype to try and live forever. The Prototype is still unknown. And he is collecting all of the dead toys and adding them to himself to become a “god”. The toys worship him because they see him as such. Specifically, when Catnap was a child he was severely sick/injured, The Prototype saved him from his sickness by turning him into a toy, so Catnap was always loyal to The Prototype. We play as an old employee returning to right our wrongs (that’s why most of the characters already know us). There was an event called the “Hour of Joy” where all of the toys retaliated and slaughtered almost all of the employees. Also, sorry it’s so long. 😭 This is the shortest I can make it with explaining the general story. Please lemme know if I missed something, hope this helps! :)
